content: [CSM]: Good morning Marcus, thank you for joining our Q3 executive account check-in for Acme Global.

metadata.call_title: Acme Global ($120k ARR) Executive Renewal & Friction Review
metadata.speaker: CSM

content: [Customer_VP]: Thanks for having me Sarah. I have to be blunt right out of the gate: our team is currently in crisis mode.

metadata.call_title: Acme Global ($120k ARR) Executive Renewal & Friction Review
metadata.speaker: Customer_VP

content: [CSM]: I'm sorry to hear that Marcus. Can you walk me through what's happening?

metadata.call_title: Acme Global ($120k ARR) Executive Renewal & Friction Review
metadata.speaker: CSM

content: [Customer_VP]: It's the Google Workspace SSO authentication desync. Our users get forcibly logged out every 20 minutes mid-session.

metadata.call_title: Acme Global ($120k ARR) Executive Renewal & Friction Review
metadata.speaker: Customer_VP

content: [CSM]: Understood. Has this been happening across all 200 seats in your enterprise workspace?

metadata.call_title: Acme Global ($120k ARR) Executive Renewal & Friction Review
metadata.speaker: CSM

content: [Customer_VP]: Yes, across all 200 engineering and product seats. It's destroying sprint momentum and wiping out draft pull requests.

metadata.call_title: Acme Global ($120k ARR) Executive Renewal & Friction Review
metadata.speaker: Customer_VP

content: [Customer_VP]: Google Workspace SSO tokens expire after 20 minutes and force users to re-login in the middle of active editing sessions.

metadata.call_title: Acme Global ($120k ARR) Executive Renewal & Friction Review
metadata.speaker: Customer_VP

content: [CSM]: That is unacceptable. Let me check the ticket logs from our engineering team on that.

metadata.call_title: Acme Global ($120k ARR) Executive Renewal & Friction Review
metadata.speaker: CSM

content: [Customer_VP]: I raised this ticket three weeks ago. We haven't had a single concrete timeline or hotfix.

metadata.call_title: Acme Global ($120k ARR) Executive Renewal & Friction Review
metadata.speaker: Customer_VP

content: [Customer_VP]: Our IT department has flagged this as an SLA violation. If SSO session persistence isn't resolved by next month we are cancelling our 200-seat contract.

metadata.call_title: Acme Global ($120k ARR) Executive Renewal & Friction Review
metadata.speaker: Customer_VP

content: [CSM]: I hear you Marcus. Acme Global is a $120k ARR anchor account for us, and I will personally escalate this to our VP of Engineering today.

metadata.call_title: Acme Global ($120k ARR) Executive Renewal & Friction Review
metadata.speaker: CSM

content: [Customer_VP]: I appreciate that Sarah, but we've already initiated conversations with Okta and a competing vendor.

metadata.call_title: Acme Global ($120k ARR) Executive Renewal & Friction Review
metadata.speaker: Customer_VP

content: [CSM]: May I ask which specific OAuth flow settings your IT team has enabled in Google Workspace?

metadata.call_title: Acme Global ($120k ARR) Executive Renewal & Friction Review
metadata.speaker: CSM

content: [Customer_VP]: We enforce strict PKCE with hourly token refreshes, but your application server refuses the refresh token and crashes with 401 Unauthorized.

metadata.call_title: Acme Global ($120k ARR) Executive Renewal & Friction Review
metadata.speaker: Customer_VP

content: [CSM]: Got it. So it's failing on silent token refresh rather than the initial login.

metadata.call_title: Acme Global ($120k ARR) Executive Renewal & Friction Review
metadata.speaker: CSM

content: [Customer_VP]: Exactly. If the user is actively typing, the modal pops up and loses unsaved form state.

metadata.call_title: Acme Global ($120k ARR) Executive Renewal & Friction Review
metadata.speaker: Customer_VP

content: [CSM]: I have documented this exact failure mode. I will commit an engineering team to a patch branch by Friday.

metadata.call_title: Acme Global ($120k ARR) Executive Renewal & Friction Review
metadata.speaker: CSM

content: [Customer_VP]: If we don't have a verified fix in staging by Friday 5 PM EST, we are withholding our renewal wire.

metadata.call_title: Acme Global ($120k ARR) Executive Renewal & Friction Review
metadata.speaker: Customer_VP

content: [CSM]: Understood. I will send you a daily update at 10 AM EST until this is deployed.

metadata.call_title: Acme Global ($120k ARR) Executive Renewal & Friction Review
metadata.speaker: CSM

content: [Customer_VP]: Thank you Sarah. We want this partnership to work, but reliability is non-negotiable for enterprise.

metadata.call_title: Acme Global ($120k ARR) Executive Renewal & Friction Review
metadata.speaker: Customer_VP
